```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
```

## Configuration

```{r config}
CFG <- list(
  data_path   = "pathogenSpikeEBM.xlsx",
  sheet       = "data",
  results_dir = "results",
  fig_dir     = "figures",
  fig_name    = "pathogen_spike_survival",
  strains     = tibble(strain = c("Klebsiella pneumoniae", "Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus"),
                       short  = c("K. pneumoniae", "E. coli", "S. aureus")),
  condition_map = c("low oxygen" = "reduced oxygen", aerobic = "aerobic"),
  conditions  = c(reduced_oxygen = "reduced oxygen", aerobic = "aerobic"),
  days        = c(0, 3, 7),
  test_days   = c(3, 7),
  baseline    = 0,
  n_reps      = 3,
  conf_level  = 0.95,
  colours     = c("reduced oxygen" = "#3B75AF", "aerobic" = "#CA6627"),
  linetypes   = c("reduced oxygen" = "dashed", "aerobic" = "solid"),
  y_breaks    = seq(0, 1.2, 0.2),
  width_mm    = 183,
  height_mm   = 80,
  base_size   = 9
)
dir.create(CFG$results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(CFG$fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Helpers

```{r helpers}
holm_sidak <- function(p) {
  n <- length(p); o <- order(p)
  adj <- cummax(1 - (1 - p[o])^(n - seq_len(n) + 1))
  out <- numeric(n); out[o] <- pmin(1, adj); out
}

p_star <- function(p) {
  case_when(is.na(p) ~ "",
            p < 0.0001 ~ "****", p < 0.001 ~ "***",
            p < 0.01 ~ "**", p < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "n.s.")
}

theme_pub <- function(base = CFG$base_size) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.line        = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.text        = element_text(colour = "black"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "italic", size = base + 1),
      legend.key.width = unit(10, "mm"),
      plot.tag         = element_text(face = "bold", size = base + 6),
      plot.margin      = margin(4, 6, 4, 4)
    )
}

save_fig <- function(plot, name, w_mm, h_mm, out_dir = CFG$fig_dir) {
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), plot,
         width = w_mm, height = h_mm, units = "mm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
  ok <- tryCatch({
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot,
           width = w_mm, height = h_mm, units = "mm",
           device = grDevices::cairo_pdf)
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) FALSE)
  if (!ok) ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot,
                  width = w_mm, height = h_mm, units = "mm")
  invisible(plot)
}

write_res <- function(df, metric_type) {
  write.csv(df, file.path(CFG$results_dir, paste0(metric_type, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}

welch <- function(a, b) {
  tt <- tryCatch(t.test(a, b, var.equal = FALSE, conf.level = CFG$conf_level),
                 error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(tt)) return(tibble(fold = 10^(mean(a) - mean(b)), ci_lower = NA_real_,
                                 ci_upper = NA_real_, t = NA_real_, df = NA_real_,
                                 p_value = NA_real_))
  tibble(fold     = 10^(mean(a) - mean(b)),
         ci_lower = 10^tt$conf.int[1],
         ci_upper = 10^tt$conf.int[2],
         t        = unname(tt$statistic),
         df       = unname(tt$parameter),
         p_value  = tt$p.value)
}
```

## Data

```{r data}
# Read the data
raw <- read_excel(CFG$data_path, sheet = CFG$sheet)

# Check the data
stopifnot("Missing columns" = all(c("strain", "condition", "replicate", "day", "cfu_per_ml") %in% names(raw)))
if (!setequal(unique(raw$strain), CFG$strains$strain)) stop("Unexpected strain labels")
if (!setequal(unique(raw$condition), names(CFG$condition_map))) stop("Unexpected condition labels")
if (!setequal(unique(raw$day), CFG$days)) stop("Unexpected days")
if (!is.numeric(raw$cfu_per_ml) || any(!is.finite(raw$cfu_per_ml) | raw$cfu_per_ml <= 0))
  stop("CFU/mL must be positive, finite numbers")
if (anyDuplicated(raw[c("strain", "condition", "replicate", "day")])) stop("Duplicate cells")
cells <- count(raw, strain, condition, replicate)
if (nrow(cells) != nrow(CFG$strains) * length(CFG$conditions) * CFG$n_reps ||
    any(cells$n != length(CFG$days))) stop("Each strain x condition needs ", CFG$n_reps,
                                           " replicates observed on every day")

dat <- raw |>
  left_join(CFG$strains, by = "strain") |>
  mutate(strain    = factor(strain, CFG$strains$strain),
         short     = factor(short, CFG$strains$short),
         condition = factor(unname(CFG$condition_map[condition]), CFG$conditions),
         log10_cfu = log10(cfu_per_ml)) |>
  arrange(strain, condition, replicate, day)
```

## Descriptives

```{r descriptives}
# Baseline normalisation
norm <- dat |>
  group_by(strain, condition, replicate) |>
  mutate(log10_change = log10_cfu - log10_cfu[day == CFG$baseline]) |>
  ungroup()

desc <- norm |>
  group_by(strain, condition, day) |>
  summarise(n                 = n(),
            mean_log10_cfu    = mean(log10_cfu),
            sd_log10_cfu      = sd(log10_cfu),
            mean_log10_change = mean(log10_change),
            sd_log10_change   = sd(log10_change),
            .groups = "drop")

write_res(select(norm, strain, condition, day, replicate, cfu_per_ml, log10_change),
          "CFU_baseline_normalised")
write_res(desc, "CFU_descriptives")
desc
```

## Primary statistics

```{r stats}
# Calculate stats
fit_strain <- function(x) {
  x <- x |>
    mutate(unit = interaction(condition, replicate, drop = TRUE)) |>
    group_by(condition, day) |> mutate(cell_mean = mean(log10_cfu)) |>
    group_by(unit) |> mutate(unit_mean = mean(log10_cfu)) |>
    group_by(condition) |> mutate(cond_mean = mean(log10_cfu)) |>
    ungroup()
  n_time <- n_distinct(x$day)
  units  <- distinct(x, unit, unit_mean, cond_mean)
  df_sub <- nrow(units) - n_distinct(x$condition)
  ms_sub <- n_time * sum((units$unit_mean - units$cond_mean)^2) / df_sub
  sigma2 <- sum((x$log10_cfu - x$cell_mean - x$unit_mean + x$cond_mean)^2) / (df_sub * (n_time - 1))
  tau2   <- max((ms_sub - sigma2) / n_time, 0)
  q      <- qt(1 - (1 - CFG$conf_level) / 2, df_sub)
  map_dfr(CFG$test_days, \(d) {
    a <- x$log10_cfu[x$day == d & x$condition == CFG$conditions[["reduced_oxygen"]]]
    b <- x$log10_cfu[x$day == d & x$condition == CFG$conditions[["aerobic"]]]
    est <- mean(a) - mean(b)
    se  <- sqrt((tau2 + sigma2) * (1 / length(a) + 1 / length(b)))
    tibble(day = d, n_reduced_oxygen = length(a), n_aerobic = length(b),
           fold = 10^est, ci_lower = 10^(est - q * se), ci_upper = 10^(est + q * se),
           t = est / se, df = df_sub, p_value = 2 * pt(-abs(est / se), df_sub))
  })
}

stats <- dat |>
  group_by(strain) |>
  group_modify(\(x, k) fit_strain(x)) |>
  mutate(p_adj = holm_sidak(p_value), stars = p_star(p_adj)) |>
  ungroup()

write_res(stats, "CFU_statistics")
stats
```

## Sensitivity

```{r sensitivity}
# Calculate stats
sens <- norm |>
  filter(day %in% CFG$test_days) |>
  pivot_longer(c(log10_cfu, log10_change), names_to = "measure", values_to = "y") |>
  mutate(test = recode(measure, log10_cfu = "Welch, log10 CFU",
                       log10_change = "Welch, change from day 0")) |>
  group_by(strain, test, day) |>
  group_modify(\(x, k) {
    a <- x$y[x$condition == CFG$conditions[["reduced_oxygen"]]]
    b <- x$y[x$condition == CFG$conditions[["aerobic"]]]
    bind_cols(tibble(n_reduced_oxygen = length(a), n_aerobic = length(b)), welch(a, b))
  }) |>
  group_by(strain, test) |>
  mutate(p_adj = holm_sidak(p_value), stars = p_star(p_adj)) |>
  ungroup()

write_res(sens, "CFU_sensitivity")
sens
```

## Figure

```{r figure, fig.width = CFG$width_mm / 25.4, fig.height = CFG$height_mm / 25.4}
# Panel
summ <- desc |>
  left_join(CFG$strains, by = "strain") |>
  mutate(short = factor(short, CFG$strains$short))

brackets <- summ |>
  filter(day %in% CFG$test_days) |>
  group_by(strain, short, day) |>
  summarise(y_lo = min(mean_log10_change), y_hi = max(mean_log10_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  inner_join(filter(stats, stars != "n.s."), by = c("strain", "day")) |>
  mutate(x = day + 0.25, tick = 0.12)

fig <- ggplot(summ, aes(day, mean_log10_change, colour = condition, fill = condition)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_log10_change - sd_log10_change,
                  ymax = mean_log10_change + sd_log10_change),
              alpha = 0.15, colour = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = condition), linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets, aes(x = x, xend = x, y = y_lo, yend = y_hi),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets, aes(x = x - tick, xend = x, y = y_lo, yend = y_lo),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets, aes(x = x - tick, xend = x, y = y_hi, yend = y_hi),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = brackets, aes(x = x + 0.08, y = (y_lo + y_hi) / 2, label = stars),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.75, size = (CFG$base_size + 2) / .pt) +
  facet_wrap(~ short, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = CFG$days, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.12))) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = CFG$y_breaks) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = CFG$colours, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = CFG$colours, name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = CFG$linetypes, name = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Time (days)",
       y = expression(paste("Change from day 0 (", log[10], " CFU/mL)"))) +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.spacing = unit(5, "mm"))

# Save
save_fig(fig, CFG$fig_name, CFG$width_mm, CFG$height_mm)
fig
```
